lure: Last chance to order Interflora flowers for Christmas
ask: Call 0800 505060 to order before midnight tomorrow

message.body: INTERFLORA - It's not too late to order Interflora flowers for christmas call 0800 505060 to place your order before Midnight tomorrow.
